data.body:
[P1] Require retirement evidence to cover previously observed activity

Comparing only start events accepts a stale retirement snapshot that omits later activity. Original evidence can contain `late_activity` at 25000 while the snapshot retains matching starts but declares retirement at 21000. The independent validator checks only that snapshot, and failed cases skip final validation of the original evidence, allowing the target to be released despite contradictory observations. Require retirement coverage and settlement bounds to cover the frozen observations, preserving previously observed activity and completion facts. Add a regression test using an older retirement snapshot.
